text:
mira: Quick heads-up — GigaSupply just pushed our EU H100 top-off ETA from 04/06 to 04/15. We’re short ~12 slots on the dedicated pool for next week. 
jonathan: ouch. Is that confirmed by them or carrier hold?
Theo (GigaSupply): Confirmed from our side — forwarder hit a manifest delay at FRA customs, clearing expected but not guaranteed until 04/14. We can do an air-expedite for the 12 units for +$6k/unit and prioritize AWB consolidation.
anna: What’s the impact if we don’t get them until 04/15? Which customers/routes degrade?
leo: We’ll hit Dedicated batch window for EU-internal jobs — latency SLOs degrade for two routes (realtime-infer and embed-bulk). We have a short-term throttling plan but throughput drops ~35%.
mira: Can we borrow from APAC/dedicated spare capacity temporarily? Cost to route cross-region?
jonathan: Cross-region routing adds egress + inter-region transfer latency; also breaks data residency for some enterprise customers. Not an option for a couple of contracts.
Theo (GigaSupply): Alternative: we can split the shipment — ship 6 units air-expedite (ETA 04/10) and leave remaining 6 on original manifest (04/15). If you want, we can also supply 4 loaner H100s from our demo pool for free for 7 days as a goodwill.
anna: Loaners sound good for the critical contracts, but need SLA paper (loaner liability + serial tracking).
leo: Ops note — loaner onboarding needs node-tag updates and inventory reconciliation. It takes ~2 hours to provision and run canaries if images are identical.
jonathan: What's the customs / RMA implication if we receive loaners and then return them? Any extra paperwork?
Theo (GigaSupply): Loaners are shipped as temporary loan-uids. We issue a proforma, return AWB, and a 30-day RMA SLA. No duties on returns if we mark as temporary import (ATA carnet style). We'll share paperwork template.
mira: Cost tradeoffs: air-expedite 6 units = +$36k, loaner route = free but mgmt overhead and RMA admin. Which is cheaper given SLO penalties?
leo: Quick calc: expected SLO penalty if degraded route active = ~$50k/week across impacted customers. So air-expedite for 6 mitigates most of it. If we take loaners for the rest, admin cost < $5k.
anna: Can ops accept the loaner RMA flow? @leo pls confirm we can turn up loaners with existing configs and onboard without infra change.
leo: Confirm — will need to patch node labels and add KV-cache warmup; can do tonight after prod window (2h). No infra changes.
jonathan: OK. Decision: ask Theo to air-expedite 6 units and send 4 loaners (we'll accept 4 loaners only — rest will come 04/15). 
Theo (GigaSupply): Got it. I'll submit expedite PO now and send AWBs + proforma. Expect AWB numbers in ~30m.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: scheduled canary window tonight 22:00 UTC to onboard loaners; ETA 2h.
mira: Thanks — please post AWB and proforma here when you have them. Also tag finance for expedite approval. :pray:
jonathan: finance heads-up: we need +$36k for expedite, charge code INF-URGENT-04.
anna: pinging finance separately.
Theo (GigaSupply): AWB: 123-EXPAIR-FRA-8441 (expedite 6), Loaner AWB: 123-LOAN-FRA-9944. Proforma link: https://files.gigasupply.example/proforma/3376543219 (will DM access).
leo: copying manifest snippet for ops inventory intake:
```
SHIPMENT: 123-EXPAIR-FRA-8441
ITEMS: 6x H100-SKU-3000
SERIALS: pending from forwarder
DEST: Redwood EU-Dedicated-Pool-3
ETA: 2024-04-10
```

mira: Perfect. I'll coordinate finance and legal on loaner paper. Thanks everyone — keep updates here.
